anchor_time_basis: estimated_relative_seconds_from_clip_start; must be edited to exact rendered_time_sec from final MediaPrep Target MP4
boundary: Anchor registration freezes timing hypotheses only. It does not certify MRED, A-MRED, NIP, TTI, OSM, consciousness, memory formation, or biological mechanism.

anchors.scene_label: Ray recognizes the approaching young man as his father / father-presence becomes narratively available
anchors.analysis_notes: Useful as an early recognition anchor, but not the primary endpoint because it may be schema recognition without the repair/integration event.
anchors.claim_boundary: Estimated timecodes must be frame-verified on the final rendered Target MP4 before strict A-MRED interpretation.

anchors.scene_label: Ray asks his father to have a catch; verbal relational repair request
anchors.analysis_notes: Primary A-MRED anchor. The prediction is not merely a gamma spike; it is Target-specific recognition plus delayed integration/carryover beyond Control and Override.
anchors.claim_boundary: Estimated timecodes must be frame-verified on the final rendered Target MP4 before strict A-MRED interpretation.

anchors.scene_label: Father accepts the request; tension resolves into reciprocal availability
anchors.expected_signal_shape: recognition-to-acceptance transition with possible theta handoff
anchors.analysis_notes: Primary anchor for whether the verbal request becomes accepted/embodied rather than only recognized.
anchors.claim_boundary: Estimated timecodes must be frame-verified on the final rendered Target MP4 before strict A-MRED interpretation.

anchors.scene_label: The first throw/catch converts the verbal request into embodied reciprocal play
anchors.expected_signal_shape: embodied_resolution; MeaningGamma/TSP may taper into theta/topological carryover
anchors.analysis_notes: Primary embodied-repair anchor. Stronger than dialogue-only if physiology follows the action transition into relational play.
anchors.claim_boundary: Estimated timecodes must be frame-verified on the final rendered Target MP4 before strict A-MRED interpretation.

anchors.scene_label: Sustained game of catch; repaired relationship stabilizes into ordinary play
anchors.expected_signal_shape: sustained immersion/integration rather than a single shock spike
anchors.analysis_notes: Better for NIP/CII/EET and Baseline2 afterglow than for a single-point strict A-MRED event.
anchors.claim_boundary: Estimated timecodes must be frame-verified on the final rendered Target MP4 before strict A-MRED interpretation.

anchors.scene_label: Terminal quiet/fade or final sustained catch moment before clip end; after-state / echo candidate
anchors.preferred_design: leave_45_to_60_seconds_post_payload_tail_if_possible; otherwise treat cross-boundary theta as sensitivity analysis
anchors.expected_signal_shape: release/afterglow; use as EET/Baseline2 support, not primary if near clip edge
anchors.analysis_notes: Clip-edge warning: if this is too close to movie end, do not use as primary A-MRED endpoint unless paired-washout continuation is predeclared.
anchors.claim_boundary: Estimated timecodes must be frame-verified on the final rendered Target MP4 before strict A-MRED interpretation.
